Actual output: '3 failed, 17 passed, 106 errors in 27.02s' (exit non-zero, no GATE PASS line). Root cause is the pre-existing, separately-filed AUG-051 defect: /api/namespaces returns a truncated list (133 entries vs 165 dirs on disk), so cmd_init (auger.py:2764, last changed in initial commit d40dad1, NOT by the AUG-036 commit ea1e80c) re-POSTs a namespace the conftest fixture already created -> 409 CONFLICT -> every ns fixture errors at setup. Verified sub-requirements: resolve_option (auger.py:3800) refuses no-match/multi-match by name with SystemExit non-zero ('nothing was written'); cmd_toggle (auger.py:3854) resolves ALL targets into `targets` before the write loop (atomic); write() (auger.py:3873) raises SystemExit when patch updated!=1 (zero-row is a hard error, not '(0)'); cmd_dump (auger.py:3924) refuses unparsable/unknown-decision/unknown-option --config before render and renders HYPOTHETICAL. Live probe (with an AUG-051 workaround): bare index 'O2' -> rc1 'ambiguous option ... matches D-001-O2, D-002-O2', no writes; bad token 'NOPE' -> rc1, no writes; 'dump --config D-001=O2' -> rc0, 'mode: HYPOTHETICAL (nothing written)', 'ACTIVE CONFIGURATION: D-001=Postgres, D-002=staging table'; '--config garbage' -> rc1 'is not a decision=option pair ... nothing rendered', empty stdout; zero-row patch -> rc1 'patched 0 rows (expected 1)'. `toggle --help`/`dump --help` advertise the accepted forms (full id, label, bare index; refusal on unresolvable/ambiguous). docs/VERBS.md:151-176 state the accepted forms. Regression tests exist: test_dump_config_bare_index_renders_hypothetical_without_mutating (tests/test_auger.py:661), test_dump_config_refuses_an_unknown_option_without_rendering (692), test_dump_config_refuses_an_unknown_decision_without_rendering (702), test_toggle_bare_index_refuses_ambiguous_matches_without_writing (752), test_toggle_resolves_all_targets_before_writing (763), test_patch_reporting_zero_updates_is_a_loud_failure (2150). With the AUG-051 workaround all 12 AUG-036 tests pass and the full suite is '1 failed, 125 passed in 397.51s' (the single failure is the child-suite meta-test also hitting the 409). The gate failure is not caused by the AUG-036 change, but the criterion explicitly requires GATE PASS and the gate fails deterministically on this host.
The AUG-036 code, help text, docs, and regression tests are all correct and verified, but `bash tests/gate.sh` fails with '3 failed, 17 passed, 106 errors' (pre-existing AUG-051 409 setup defect) and never prints GATE PASS, so the criterion is not met.
